maria gonzalez: Hey team — preparing AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace onboarding for Redwood Dedicated. Need final list of staging credentials, legal artifacts, SKU mapping, and hero assets. Can owners drop their items? Target: EOD Wed.

alex chen: Adding our items: AWS Seller ID, billing contact email, AMI IDs (staging), ECR repo, and a signed Publisher Agreement. Also need a staging AWS account with role to upload AMIs.

maria gonzalez: @alex are we sticking with AMIs or moving to container images for AWS? Azure needs VM images; GCP needs image names in the project.

alex chen: AMIs for initial launch. Staging AMI: ami-0c55b159cbfafe1f0 (tag: redwood-dedicated-staging). ECR: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/dedicated:staging

jonathan li: Legal checklist: EULA, signed Publisher MSA, SOC attachments. @katie any change to trial terms? Need trial metadata for SKU (trial_length_days).

katie peters: Trials = 14 days. We need trial_only flag and entitlement mapping. Marketing requires short description (<=300 chars), hero image 1024x512 JPG, icon 128x128 PNG, and 4 screenshots 1024x768.

luis rodriguez: Ops: please provision these staging principals/IDs and grant upload permissions:
```
- AWS role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MarketplaceUploader
- GCP project: redwood-marketplace-staging
- Azure subscription: 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555
- Service principal: redwood-marketplace-staging-sp
```
Grant s3/obj upload + image register.

marketplace-bot: Assigned PLAT-842 to @katie, @alex, @maria. Onboarding deadline 2026-03-25. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-842 :spiral_calendar:

maria gonzalez: @luis can you paste the exact IAM policy we should include in the vendor docs?

```
{\"Version\":\"2012-10-17\",\"Statement\":[{\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Action\":\[\"ec2:DescribeImages\",\"ec2:RegisterImage\",\"s3:PutObject\"\],\"Resource\":\"*\"}]}
```

jonathan li: Also need publisher contact (name/email) + tax forms (W-9/W-8) for marketplace billing. Non-US customers need W-8.

katie peters: Marketing will need copy & assets by Friday to hit publish window. Can design deliver hero + screenshots by Thu if we get raw images.

alex chen: Pricing SKU mapping: draft SKUs = RDW-DED-PAYG, RDW-DED-MONTH, RDW-DED-ENT. Need meter dimensions and unit descriptions. I'll upload draft mapping to PLAT-842.

maria gonzalez: Timeline: QA in staging 2026-03-24 10-12 PT. Legal sign-off 2026-03-25. Publish window 03/26-03/28. Confirm availability for QA slot?

jonathan li: I can do QA 03/24 10-12 PT.
